Your Role
Here's what you will be doing:

Design, implement, and maintain physical infrastructure components, including data centers, server rooms, and associated hardware.
Ensure stability, availability, and performance of all technology infrastructure.
Manage capacity planning and growth for computing and storage resources.
Work on Infrastructure Management within Technology Services, supporting Citi's global operations.
Gain exposure to technologies such as Microservices Development (Java, Spring Framework, Pivotal Cloud Foundry), Front-End Web Development (React, Angular, Apigee, TypeScript, HTML5), Generative AI & AI Agents (GitHub Copilot, Devin.AI, Prompt Engineering), and Data Analytics (Splunk, Tableau, Adobe Analytics).
Participate in globally scoped projects with cross-functional teams.
Contribute to real-world projects shaping the future of banking, including digital banking solutions, cybersecurity, and data-driven innovations.
About You
The company is looking for:

Graduates between December 2027 and July 2028.
Educational background in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, or related tech degrees.
Preferred GPA of 3.0 or higher.
A proactive problem-solver who embraces innovation and leverages Generative AI to solve complex business problems.
A global outlook with willingness to collaborate across cultures and time zones.
Excellent communication, project management, leadership skills, attention to detail, and ability to work well within diverse teams.
Ability to pass technical interviews involving basic algorithmic programming exercises.
Collaborative and adaptable, with prior experience in agile teams desirable.
Authorized to work in the Philippines without employer sponsorship now or in the future.
Compensation & Benefits
Participation in a 10-week Summer Analyst Program starting in June, including in-depth education on the Analyst role and Citi's culture.
On-the-desk training, speaker series, and networking opportunities.
Structured learning, mentoring, and development programs to enhance technical, business, and leadership skills.
